ranking_criteria: isolation: zero coupling to BrainSession instance/class state (low risk)
cohesion: methods form a logical bundle

candidates.name: _fmt_* tool result formatters bundle
candidates.isolation: PERFECT (all 17: self_uses_total=0, cls_uses_total=0, no cross-fmt calls, no external repo callers)
candidates.callers: only via _TOOL_FORMATTERS dispatcher (L4780-4800) → _format_tool_result (L4803-4847) via getattr(cls, name)
candidates.rationale: Cleanest extraction in the file. Largest single isolated bundle (52% of all pure-modular lines). Already validated by B7-05 inventory as runner-up C2.

candidates.name: _format_tool_result + _format_action_value + _TOOL_FORMATTERS
candidates.isolation: _format_tool_result uses cls.* attribute access for getattr(cls, name) — moving it requires either passing the registry+resolver, or moving formatters with it
candidates.shim_strategy: delegating method that calls module function with cls or registry argument
candidates.rationale: Coupled to _fmt_* dispatch via getattr(cls,...). Better extracted AFTER C1 in a follow-up (B7-07). Higher complexity per line moved.

candidates.name: _render_* operational summaries
candidates.isolation: both are classmethods with self_uses=0; cls_uses>0 (cls.* attribute access for sibling classmethods)
candidates.shim_strategy: delegate to module function with extra cls/dependency arguments
candidates.rationale: Sizable, but cls_uses>0 means cross-method dependencies need re-wiring. Lower cohesion than C1.

candidates.name: _truncate_to_budget + _truncate_message + _context_budget
candidates.isolation: _context_budget is an instance method (uses self.* config), couples cluster to BrainSession state
candidates.rationale: Mixed bundle (instance + class + static). _context_budget keeps it tethered. Defer.

candidates.name: _extract_* + _build_* + _slice_lines + _find_test_references (grounded code helpers)
candidates.scope: _extract_candidate_paths (26L static), _extract_symbol_hint (17L static), _slice_lines (7L static), _build_grounded_file_excerpt (43L classmethod cls=2), _find_test_references (17L classmethod cls=0), _build_test_reference_excerpt (7L classmethod cls=2)
candidates.isolation: good: most are static or pure classmethod; 2 helpers use cls.* for sibling helpers
candidates.rationale: Solid contiguous block (L3984-L4110). Smaller than C1 but well-cohesive. Strong B7-07 candidate.

candidates.name: Query intent helpers: _prefers_no_tool_analysis + _has_explicit_tool_target + _sanitize_memory_content + _looks_like_canned_failure + _looks_like_deep_analysis + _contains_raw_tool_markup
candidates.rationale: Lower cohesion (different domains). Better split into 2-3 modules later.

candidates.name: _should_use_compact_chat_prompt + _should_use_analysis_frontier
candidates.scope: L2174-2247, both classmethod, cls_uses=8 and 14 respectively
candidates.rationale: cls.* coupling to other prompt-strategy classmethods makes shim harder.

candidates.name: Static utilities: _persist_chat_dev_mode_default + _load_chat_dev_mode_default + _utility_score + _utility_blockers + _blocks_grounded_ui_edit_fastpath
candidates.rationale: Too small individually, low cohesion across them. Roll-up later.

candidates.name: _is_* small predicates not yet extracted (30 pure, 65L)
candidates.scope: 30 small classifier predicates at various locations
candidates.rationale: B7-03 already extracted the cohesive query-intent _is_* set. Remainder is scattered/heterogeneous; lower ROI per line moved.

candidates.name: _cmd_* slash-command handlers (31 methods, 703 lines)
candidates.isolation: all use self heavily (instance methods); 0 pure
candidates.rationale: Largest single group BUT all instance methods. Would require splitting per-command handlers and broad refactor. Out of scope for strangler-style B7.

selection_reasoning: Largest fully-pure isolated bundle in session.py (295 lines, 52% of all pure-modular surface).
Zero internal coupling: all 17 methods have self_uses=0 AND cls_uses=0 AND no cross-fmt calls.
Zero external repo callers (verified via repo-wide scan in _b7_06_inventory_extra.json).
Single dispatcher entry point (_TOOL_FORMATTERS + _format_tool_result via getattr(cls, name)) — preservable with same-arity classmethod shims.
Already pre-identified as the natural B7-06 successor in B7-05 inventory (runner-up C2).
Lowest implementation risk per line moved across all candidates.
